title: Resource-Aware Model Selection for Scalable Indoor Localization on HPC Platforms
summary: Large-scale indoor localization is increasingly needed in campuses, smart buildings, factories, and digital-twin infrastructures, where wireless conditions, access-point deployments, and spatial layouts evolve over time. Such systems must be accurate, extendable, and maintainable, allowing new buildings, floors, rooms, and service areas to be added without retraining a monolithic model.
